headline: A strong recovery possible in H2FY27

highlights: Although bromine volumes increased, they were affected by production downtime on power outages.
ACI expects bromine volumes to be at the lower end of its FY27 guidance of 18–20kte, with blended realisations of INR 300/kg.
Its subsidiary Acume Chemicals witnessed strong revenue growth, while new product development is likely to ramp-up utilisation.
We cut FY27E/FY28E EBITDA by 8%/5% factoring in higher costs.
valuation: We reduce our TP to INR 620 (from INR 655), based on an unchanged 16x FY28E EBITDA multiple.
Upside risks: Higher-than-expected bromine volumes and prices; and success in bromine derivative business.
The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Retail Research.
